name: sa-reverse-engineering-toolkit
description: Reverse-engineering toolkit for SAs: layered code analysis (dependencies, variables, ERD, functions, flowchart, business rules, system design, system analysis, API contract) and spec-vs-code verification, for both single-repo monoliths and multi-service workspaces (separated frontend/backend, or microservices sharing one parent folder), driven by profile cards and a deterministic static-analysis facts layer. Forked and extended from code-analysis-package (https://github.com/jin576tw/code-analysis-package).
